notes.title: First Break Labs - Lunar New Year Sale!
notes.content:
As we usher in the Year of the Snake, we’re excited to bring some great news for our loyal players and newcomers alike! To celebrate the Lunar New Year, we're offering fantastic discounts on four of our popular titles: Entropy Survivors, Cthulhu's Reach: Devil Reef, SPINGUN, and David - from now until [b]February 10th.[/b] This is the perfect time to add them to your collection at a reduced price!

Here’s a quick look at each game:

[h1][b]Entropy Survivors[/b][/h1]
Entropy Survivors is a bullet hell roguelike where you simultaneously control a powerful mech and a sharpshooting space frog, featuring outrageously creative abilities and powerful weapon customization. Save the universe in single player or 2-4 player online co-op!

Entropy Survivors - 20% Off

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2602030/Entropy_Survivors/


[h1][b]Cthulhu’s Reach: Devil Reef[/b][/h1]
Prepare for a chilling journey into the heart of darkness with Devil Reef, an action-packed roguelike co-op dungeon crawler developed by The Fine Arc Nordic AB. Immerse yourself in a haunting universe inspired by H.P. Lovecraft's twisted tales, where pixel-art graphics and atmospheric soundscapes pay homage to the golden era of 90s gaming.

Cthulhu's Reach: Devil Reef - 15% Off 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2412200/Cthulhus_Reach_Devil_Reef/


[h1][b]SPINGUN[/b][/h1]
SPINGUN is a "manic two-button arcade shooter". Two buttons. One spaceship. Zero chance to survive.

SPINGUN - 50% Off 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/548230/SPINGUN/


[h1][b]David[/b][/h1]
You play David, an awfully small abstracted chosen hero tossed into a blissfully simple world overrun by giant culminations of evil physics-beasts. As David, you are given a slingshot-esque gift that you will have to use to conquer your colossus foes. Be there AND be square.

David. - 50% Off 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/346180/David/


[h1]Lunar New Year Sale Details:[/h1]
The First Break Labs Lunar New Year Sale runs from now until February 10th.

[b]Discounts:[/b]

Cthulhu's Reach: Devil Reef - 15% Off 
Entropy Survivors - 20% Off 
David. - 50% Off 
SPINGUN - 50% Off 

So, what are you waiting for? Head to our Steam store page, grab your favorites, and get ready to dive into these fantastic worlds at a fraction of the price!

Happy Lunar New Year from all of us – may this year bring you good fortune, thrilling adventures, and endless fun!

notes.title: 1.4.4.0 Small update to fix FPS issue
notes.content:
There was an issue with the framerate after a recent windows update that caused the game to stutter in an annoying way, leading to max framerate of around 20-30fps. I've updated the project to Gamemaker Studio 2 (from 1.4) and hopefully fixed this issue. Let me know if you find any problems with this update, thanks!

<3 Fermenter

notes.title: SPINGUN Launch Week Competition!
notes.content:
Alright, SPINGUN is launched, and the fun is just beginning. :D

[h1]Competition Rules[/h1]

[b]// Summary[/b]

It's simple! There are 15 leaderboards in game that are looking a bit empty at the moment. I challenge you to get the best times you possibly can by the end of next week.

All leaderboards are up for grabs: both "Endless" modes, all 8 "Zones", 3 "Bosses", "Ballpit", and "Total Kills".

The official deadline for your times and rankings will be next Friday, November 18th, at 11:59PM (EST).

[b]// Prizes[/b]

The Top 3 times for each leaderboard will receive an exclusive fancy boost trail, Gold, Silver, or Bronze, depending on how they ranked.

(1st place will receive all trails, 2nd place will receive Silver and Bronze, and 3rd place will receive only Bronze.)

All Top 3 times will also receive a free Steam Key for my other game, "David."! (Only one key per winner.)

[b]/////////////[/b]


Let me know if there are any questions.

Thanks for playing SPINGUN. Good luck and have fun!
